Plug the hair dryer into a suitable power outlet

Adjust the airflow according to your styling needs

Safety Information
Do not use the hair dryer in bathrooms or near water
Do not immerse the hair dryer in water
Keep away from wet surfaces and liquids
Do not use if the product or power cable is damaged
Allow the dryer to cool before storage

Keep air vents clear to ensure proper ventilation
